fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the Fees Refund  Link for the Non Technical Popular Categories NTPC Graduate Level Post. This recruitment was released for 8113 posts. The applications for RRB NTPC Graduate Level Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 14 September 2024 to 20 October 2024. The Typing Test examination was held on 11 February 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RRB NTPC Graduate Level 05/2024 Fees Refund 2026 from the link given below.

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)

RRB NTPC Graduate 05/2024 Fees Refund 2026

RRB NTPC Graduate Level CEN 05/2024

  • Application Start Date : 14 September 2024
  • Last Date : 20 October 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 October 2024
  • Correction / Modified Form : 21 to 22 October 2024
  • Exam Date : 05-23 June 2025

  • Typing Test Date : 11 February 2026
  • Final Result : 07 May 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General : Rs. 400/-
  • OBC, EWS, SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

RRB NTPC Graduate Level Notification 2024 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 January 2025
  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 36 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per RRB NTPC Graduate Level Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

Total Posts : 8113 Posts

RRB NTPC Graduate Level Bharti 2024 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates having Graduation degree in any Stream from any recognized university / college will be considered for this post.
  • Typing proficiency in English / Hindi on Computer is essential.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

RRB NTPC Graduate Level Online Form 2024 : Mode of Selection

  • CBT Written Exam
  • Typing Test (If Applicable)
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

How To Download RRB NTPC Graduate Level 05/2024 Final Result 2026

  • Candidates must go to the Important Links section below
  • Then the candidates must click on the Download Final Result link.
  • After clicking on the link, the candidates will be redirected to a new page.
  • In this page, candidates have to enter the following details:
  • Login ID
  • Password
  • Then the candidates have to  submit the details by clicking on the Login button
  • After successful login, candidates will be able to download the final result.
  • Alternatively, the candidates can download the Railway RRB NTPC Graduate Level final result from the official website of RRBs also.

Important Question

Q. Has the RRB NTPC Graduate Level 05/2024 Final Result been released?
Answer. Yes, the RRB NTPC Graduate Level 05/2024 Final Result has been released on the official website of RRB.

Q. When was the RRB NTPC Graduate Level 05/2024 Final Result released?
Answer. The final result was released on 07 May 2026.

Q. Where can the final result be downloaded from?
Answer. The final result is available on the official RRB website: indianrailways.gov.in

Q. Is the result in PDF format?
Answer. Yes, the result is available in PDF format, making it easy to download and view.

Q. Are the cut-off marks mentioned in the result?
Answer. Yes, the cut-off marks for different categories are provided in the PDF along with the result.

Q. What is RRB Official Website?
Answer. The Official Website of RRB is https://indianrailways.gov.in/
